name: CHAPSCoPCheckCompleted
trigger: SVC-009 receives CoP result from Pay.UK CoP service (or timeout resulting in unavailable). Records cop_result and cop_checked_at on CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052). Published to allow SVC-001 to update CHAPSPaymentIntent status and surface the result to the channel.
capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to update CHAPSPaymentIntent status. Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-001.

payload_schema.cop_matched_name: string (nullable) — name as held at receiving bank; present on partial_match if returned by CoP scheme

excluded_fields.note: Excluded — CAP-001 already holds these from EVT-108

consumers.action: Updates CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053) status to cop_complete. Stores cop_result. If no_match or partial_match: status exposed to channel awaiting customer CoP confirmation.
Records CoP check result for GOV-003-R02 audit evidence

ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via chaps_intent_id. Emitted after CoP result received — always after EVT-108 for the same intent.
worm_rationale: CoP result is audit evidence for GOV-003-R02 (Consumer Duty). Required for PSR compliance evidence.
